svg.title: 4K Hyprland frame captured on NVIDIA: wallpaper, bar and GPU application verified; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 acceptance gates complete
svg.desc: The 4K wallpaper, bar and readable GPU application capture was verified twice in direct-start guests. One fresh UWSM-managed PAM/logind session also passes active compositor/graphical target checks, five GPU application cycles and complete live cleanup. Its repeat exceeds the unchanged 1 GiB reported GPU usage guard and remains rejected. Four backend stages are demonstrated; stages five and six are in progress. No desktop product gate is complete: normal first-boot/launcher/input, continuous multi-window display, stability, recovery and performance remain open. Counts are checklists, not effort percentages. Updated October 19, 2026.

g.text: 4K Hyprland frame captured · NVIDIA GPU · 3/3 scene elements
UWSM + five GPU app cycles pass once · Repeat hits 1 GiB GPU usage guard
Next: normal launcher/input + sustained multi-window display · Test client: 1280×720
Green: verified · Amber: in progress · Gray: pending · Updated 2026-10-19
Checklist counts do not measure engineering effort or product readiness.
